## Model Links
[🤗 drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16) (recommended) · [🤗 drbaph/FireRedTTS3-int8](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-int8) (smallest, experimental) · [🤗 FireRedTeam/FireRedTTS3](https://huggingface.co/FireRedTeam/FireRedTTS3) (official fp32)

All three repos share the same layout; the loader downloads only the variant you select plus the shared components.

**fireredtts3_base / fireredtts3_instruct** (choose one or both)

- [model.safetensors (base)](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16/resolve/main/fireredtts3_base/model.safetensors)
- [model.safetensors (instruct)](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16/resolve/main/fireredtts3_instruct/model.safetensors)

**redae**

- [model.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16/resolve/main/redae/model.safetensors)

**campp** (base variant only)

- [campplus_voxceleb.bin](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16/resolve/main/campp/campplus_voxceleb.bin)

**text_tokenizer**

- [tokenizer.json](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16/resolve/main/text_tokenizer/tokenizer.json)

**fasttext** (language auto-detect)

- [lid.176.ftz](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16/resolve/main/fasttext/lid.176.ftz)

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
└── 📂 models/
    └── 📂 fireredtts3/
        └── 📂 drbaph_FireRedTTS3-bf16/
        │   ├── 📂 fireredtts3_base/
        │   │   ├── config.json
        │   │   └── model.safetensors
        │   ├── 📂 fireredtts3_instruct/
        │   │   ├── config.json
        │   │   └── model.safetensors
        │   ├── 📂 redae/
        │   │   ├── config.json
        │   │   └── model.safetensors
        │   ├── 📂 campp/
        │   │   └── campplus_voxceleb.bin
        │   └── 📂 text_tokenizer/
        │       ├── tokenizer.json
        │       ├── tokenizer_config.json
        │       └── vocab.json
        └── 📂 fasttext/
            └── lid.176.ftz
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and pick a weight repo in the FireRedTTS3 Load Model node (`FireRedTTS3-bf16` recommended); it downloads automatically when `download_if_missing` is on.

- This node pack [issues](https://github.com/Saganaki22/FireRedTTS3-ComfyUI/issues)

## FireRedTTS3

[FireRedTTS3](https://github.com/FireRedTeam/FireRedTTS3) is FireRed Team's unified speech generation and editing model. It does zero-shot voice cloning across **24 languages and 21 Chinese dialects**, and the Instruct variant adds natural-language **voice design** plus **semantic and acoustic speech editing** in one model.

## ComfyUI links
- [Saganaki22/FireRedTTS3-ComfyUI](https://github.com/Saganaki22/FireRedTTS3-ComfyUI)
- [🤗 drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/FireRedTTS3-bf16)

## About this workflow

This template runs **zero-shot voice cloning** with the `FireRedTTS3VoiceClone` node: a short reference clip plus its transcript is turned into new speech in the same voice.

**Key inputs**

- **repo**: weight source in the loader — `FireRedTTS3-bf16` (recommended, official-equivalent mixed precision), `FireRedTTS3-int8` (int8 ConvRot, smallest), or `FireRedTTS3-fp32` (official)
- **variant**: `fireredtts3_instruct` (default; cloning + design + editing) or `fireredtts3_base` (cloning with explicit language/dialect tags)
- **prompt_audio / prompt_text**: a clean 5–20s reference clip and its exact transcript. The `FireRedTTS3WhisperTranscribe` node produces the transcript and passes the audio through; wire `audio` → `prompt_audio`, and right-click the clone node to convert `prompt_text` to an input for the `transcript`
- **language**: `auto` detects via FastText (24 languages), or pick any of the 24 languages / 21 Chinese dialects explicitly. Match the reference clip's language for best cloning
- **seed / n_timesteps / inference_cfg / stop_threshold**: official defaults are 10 flow steps, CFG 2.0 for cloning (1.2 for design/edits), stop threshold 0.5

**Notes**

- Voice Design, Semantic Edit, and Acoustic Edit require the `fireredtts3_instruct` variant; the node error tells you exactly what to switch if the wrong variant is connected
- Long text is split into sentences and cross-faded automatically (`do_split`), with local wetext normalization for numbers/dates in Chinese and English (`do_tn`)
- Reference audio longer than ~655 seconds is rejected (RedAE encoder limit); 5–20s clones best
- bf16 and int8 checkpoints produce output matching the official fp32 model; int8 roughly halves VRAM in exchange for ~30% slower generation
